# Project Setup

```{r}
#| label:  setup

cran <- c("devtools", "tidyverse", "openxlsx", "rMVP", "CMplot", "R.utils")
git <- c("hemstrow/snpR") 

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  for (pkg in cran) { 
    if( !require(pkg, character.only = TRUE) ) {
      install.packages(pkg)
      library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
    } 
  }
  
  for (pkg in git) {
    if( !require(sub(".*/", "", pkg), character.only = TRUE) ) {
      devtools::install_github(pkg, upgrade = TRUE)
      library(sub(".*/", "", pkg), character.only = TRUE)
    }
  }
}); remove(cran, git, pkg)

source("https://inkaverse.com/docs.r")

cat("Project: ", getwd(), "\n")
cat("cores: ", parallel::detectCores())
cores <- parallel::detectCores()*0.8
session_info()


```

# Import data

```{r}

datos_completos <- read_csv2("datasets/tabla_pollos.csv")

info <- datos_completos %>%
  rename(id = "Sample ID", 
         region = "Geographic region", 
         distrito = "District")

pheno <- datos_completos %>%
  select(id = "Sample ID", peso = "body weight (kg)")

names(pheno)

geno <- snpR::read_vcf("datasets/chickens_small.vcf.gz")

nombres_vcf <- sample.meta(geno)$sampID

indices <- match(nombres_vcf, info$id)
sample.meta(geno)$region <- info$region[indices]
sample.meta(geno)$distrito <- info$distrito[indices]


geno
sample.meta(geno)
snp.meta(geno)

```

# PCA raw-data

```{r}
pca <- plot_clusters(geno
                     , facets = "region"
                     , check_duplicates = T
                     , plot_type = "pca"
                     )

pca$plots$pca
```

# rMVP: Memory-efficient, Visualization-enhanced, and Parallel-accelerated Genome-Wide Association Study

## Import data

```{r}

pheno %>%
  write_csv("datasets/pheno_pollos.csv")

library(R.utils)

if (!file.exists("datasets/chickens_small.vcf")) {
  gunzip("datasets/chickens_small.vcf.gz", remove = FALSE)}


MVP.Data(fileVCF = "datasets/chickens_small.vcf"
         , filePhe = "datasets/pheno_pollos.csv"
         , sep.phe = ","
         , priority = "speed"
         , fileKin = FALSE
         , filePC = FALSE
         , out = "datasets/rmvp/gwas_pollos"
         )
```

## Kinship

```{r}

MVP.Data.Kin(fileKin = TRUE
             , mvp_prefix = 'datasets/rmvp/gwas_pollos' 
             , out = 'datasets/rmvp/gwas_pollos'
             )
```

## Data input

```{r}
phenotype <- read.table("datasets/rmvp/gwas_pollos.phe", head = TRUE)
genotype <- attach.big.matrix("datasets/rmvp/gwas_pollos.geno.desc")
mapping <- read.table("datasets/rmvp/gwas_pollos.geno.map", head = TRUE)
kinship <- attach.big.matrix("datasets/rmvp/gwas_pollos.kin.desc")
```

## GWAS

```{r}
phenotype %>% names()

trait <- phenotype %>% select(1, "peso")

imMVP <- MVP(
  phe = trait
  , geno = genotype
  , map = mapping
  , K = kinship
  , method = c("GLM", "MLM", "FarmCPU")
  , outpath = "datasets/rmvp/gwas_pollos"
  , file.output = TRUE
  , file.type = "csv"
  , ncpus = cores
  )

gc()
```

## SNP density-plot

```{r}
MVP.Report(MVP = imMVP
           , plot.type="d"
           , col=c("darkgreen", "yellow", "red")
           , file.type = "jpg", dpi = 300
           , outpath = "datasets/rmvp/gwas_pollos"
           )
```

## Phenotype distribution

```{r}
MVP.Hist(phe = trait
         , outpath = "datasets/rmvp/gwas_pollos"
         , file.type = "jpg", breakNum = 18, dpi = 300)
```

## Manhatan

```{r}
MVP.Report(imMVP
           , plot.type = "m"
           , multracks = TRUE
           , threshold = c(1e-6, 1e-4)
           , threshold.lty=c(1,2)
           , threshold.lwd=c(1,1)
           , threshold.col=c("black","grey")
           , amplify = TRUE
           , bin.size = 1e6
           , chr.den.col = c("darkgreen", "yellow", "red")
           , signal.col = c("red","green")
           , signal.cex = c(1,1)
           , file.type = "jpg", memo = "", dpi = 300
           , outpath = "datasets/rmvp/gwas_pollos"
        )
```

## Q-Q plot

```{r}
MVP.Report(imMVP
           , plot.type = "q"
           , col = c("dodgerblue1", "olivedrab3", "darkgoldenrod1")
           , threshold = 1e6
           , signal.pch = 19
           , signal.cex = 1.5
           , signal.col = "red"
           , box = FALSE 
           , multracks = TRUE
           , file.type="jpg",memo="",dpi=300
           , outpath = "datasets/rmvp/gwas_pollos"
           )
```
